title: Sourcing planner data
subtitle: The tables every advisor run reads as they stand: buffer overrides and stock confidence, product rules and lists, and the planner tables.

access.deniedTitle: No access to the planner data
access.deniedHint: Each planner table needs one of the three planner grants. Ask an administrator for the one you need.
access.unreachableTitle: Your access could not be checked
access.unreachableHint: The server did not answer. Try again in a moment.

overrides.keepDays: Given both, the larger of the two applies.

confidence.confidence: 0.60 to 1.00. It never removes a last unit.
confidence.endDay: At most 90 days ahead. After it, the store goes back to 1.00.

rules.group: The class, status, list or item code the rule is about.
rules.stores: Store codes, for an "only from named stores" rule.

restricted.item: The item's code. Items SAP marks come from SAP.

bulky.code: An item's code, or a sub-category.

contracts.assumed: An assumed row keeps a version with a carrier mode on from being the candidate set.

slots.ordersUntil: An order after this time gets the next slot.

override.beatsNone: The least specific level: every other level wins over it.

keep.UNITS: Keeps {{units}} units back from online orders.
keep.DAYS: Keeps {{days}} days of walk-in sales back from online orders.
keep.BOTH: Keeps the larger of {{units}} units and {{days}} days of walk-in sales.

probe.title: Which override applies today?
probe.idle: Choose a store, an item or a category.
probe.none: No override applies: the computed buffer stands.

reason.label: Reason (kept with the change)
reason.hint: Kept with who changed what and when. Required.
reason.none: This table keeps who changed what and when, and the old and new values. It keeps no reason.

locked.SAP: From SAP's Restricted Drugs status. It cannot be changed here.

notes.overrides: A planner's override replaces the computed buffer, up or down. The most specific level wins.
notes.confidence: Every store not listed runs at 1.00. Nothing works it out: a planner sets one store's by hand, for a time.
notes.rules: A row keeps an item group off a mode, or on named stores only. A pin never overrides a rule. A prescription line is planned on every mode.
notes.restricted: A restricted item is pick-up only. SAP's Restricted Drugs status comes from SAP; our own list starts empty.
notes.bulky: A bulky item stays off Dawaa Now.
notes.storeModes: Which store ships by which mode. Serving lists are not read.
notes.contracts: Both carrier modes are off in the baseline set. A version with a carrier mode on cannot be the candidate set while a row it uses is assumed.
notes.slots: The fallback when Hybris does not answer, and for a run planned for another hour.
notes.everyRun: Every run reads it as it stands; a change bites within a minute.

problems.badUnits: Units are a whole number, 0 or more.
problems.badDays: Days are a number, 0 or more.
problems.lastBeforeFirst: The last day is before the first day.
problems.endTooFar: The end date may be at most 90 days ahead.
problems.endPast: The end date must be after today.

list.failed: The table could not be read
list.clickHint: Click a row to change it, end it or read its history.

sheet.ended: Ended {{at}}, by {{by}}. It stays in the history.
sheet.neverInPlace: Saving ends this row and writes a new one; the old one stays in the history.
sheet.historyFailed: The history could not be read
sheet.failedFallback: The server did not answer as expected.

toast.added: Row added. The next run reads it.
toast.saved: Row changed. The old version stays in the history.
toast.ended: Row ended. It stays in the history.
toast.switchedOn: Switched on. The next run obeys it.
toast.switchedOff: Switched off. The next run ignores it.
